coordinate_system: Godot/glTF Y-up. outline=[X,Z]. Identity stage transform; do not flip Z or rescale.
collision_contract: Only these exact grass-top triangles. No cliff, tree, bush, rock, flower, circle, or convex-hull colliders.
shoreline_angle_convention: index k -> angle k * TAU / 512; direction (cos(angle), sin(angle)); matches atan(z,x); wrap repeat enabled
